title: Deposits That Come Back Whole When a Package Is Given Up
content:
On a product in Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products that returns the deposit on cancellation, the deposit taken on the package is ring-fenced: it comes back to the party whole and the figure the ladder gives is reduced by it. The deposit taken is what the deposit lines on the package ledger come to.

**Where the product returns the deposit on cancellation and the deposit taken on the package is less than the figure the ladder gives**, the figure the ladder gives is reduced by the deposit taken, which is ring-fenced and comes back to the party whole.

**Where the product returns the deposit on cancellation and the deposit taken on the package is at least the figure the ladder gives**, nothing is withheld on the ladder at all, the ring-fenced deposit covering it.

**Where the product does not return the deposit on cancellation**, the figure the ladder gives is not reduced under this note.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Deposit returnable on the product | The deposit taken against the figure the ladder gives | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | less than that figure | that figure less the deposit taken |
| yes | equal to or greater than that figure | nothing is withheld on the ladder |
| no | either | not reduced under this note |

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

On a product whose deposit is returnable, a package whose deposit lines come to 2,000.00 USD with a ladder figure of 3,200.00 USD: the deposit taken is less than that figure, so the ladder figure becomes 1,200.00 USD and the 2,000.00 USD comes back to the party whole.

The same package with a ladder figure of 2,000.00 USD: the deposit taken is at least that figure, so nothing is withheld on the ladder.

The same package with a ladder figure of 1,500.00 USD: the deposit taken is again at least that figure, so nothing is withheld on the ladder, and the deposit still comes back to the party whole rather than in part.
